text:
Mia: FYI — nightly invoice batch run_2026_03_19_02 produced ~48 invoices with missing line items and 12 customers got duplicate invoices. filing here so ops + billing-eng can triage.
Leo: looking now. can you drop a couple sample invoice ids and a run id? I’ll check renderer logs.
Mia: sample invoice ids: INV-ACME-00072, INV-BRITE-00421, INV-NOVA-0103. run id is run_2026_03_19_02. Customer reported missing seat charges and duplicated subscription line.
Sofia: customer support saw first complaint from Acme (acct_acme_01) at 07:14 PT. ticket SF-9842 opened. shared repro pdf they received (missing middle section).
Leo: grabbing renderer logs. initial finding: PDF render service hit a page boundary error and retried job without idempotency token, which can cause duplicate PDF generation + suppressed lines when the renderer aborts mid-stream.
Leo: snippet from logs:
```
2026-03-19T07:12:03Z ERROR render_worker: UnhandledException: PageOverflowException at render_page (customer=acct_acme_01, invoice=INV-ACME-00072)
2026-03-19T07:12:04Z WARN retry_loop: requeued job id=job_49872 (no idempotency_key)
2026-03-19T07:12:06Z INFO pdf_store: wrote pdf tmp/inv_INV-ACME-00072_v2.pdf
```
Raj: can you confirm which customers were affected? we need a compiled list to pause collections and prepare credits.
Mia: initial list from support: acct_acme_01, acct_bright_88, acct_novahealth_3, acct-zen-12, acct-gamma-77 (total 60 invoices across variations, but 12 duplicates reported so far).
Amanda: hold collections for those accounts. finance will prepare pre-approval for credits. estimated exposure? ballpark?
Raj: rough estimate from quick lookup ~ $1.4k in net revenue affected (mostly seat-month proration + one-time onboarding fees). we'll confirm.
Leo: root cause: renderer didn't propagate idempotency_key from billing pipeline to render worker; retry loop simply requeued causing second invoice file in PDF store while the original job had partially written lines that downstream reconciliation treats as missing. patch incoming.
Mia: can we pause the scheduled job until patch is live?
Leo: yes — pausing now. command I ran: `ssh infra@batch01 "systemctl stop invoice-batch-runner"` — stopped cron for nightly run. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for branch billing/render-idempotency-fix -> staging
Sofia: support to customers: will hold replies until we have exact regen ETA. one customer already called billing; they're annoyed. want proactive outreach.
Leo: hotfix plan: 1) enforce idempotency token in pipeline 2) make render worker atomic (write to tmp then rename) 3) backfill script to detect suppressed line items and re-generate affected invoices. estimate 90-120m to deploy + run backfill.
Mia: ok. priority: patch, regen affected invoices, notify customers with corrected PDFs and a one-time $25 credit for inconvenience. please cc billing for audit trail.
Raj: assigning followups: billing-1234 (do-not-merge) created and assigned to @Leo. I'll prepare a billing memo for CS and collections.
Amanda: once regen complete, finance needs final list to post credits and adjust revenue recognition if needed. please attach journal entries.
Leo: staging deploy looks green. running backfill in dry-run to enumerate invoices: `python tools/invoice_backfill.py --run-id run_2026_03_19_02 --dry-run` -> found 48 invoices with missing lines, 12 duplicates.
Leo: after dry-run, running fix now. will post results when done.
Mia: thanks. avoid sending credit memos until we confirm final counts. ping this thread when backfill completes. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Deploy to production succeeded for billing/render-idempotency-fix @ 2026-03-19T09:05:12Z
Leo: prod backfill finished: regenerated 48 invoices, deduped 12 duplicates, pushed corrected PDFs to invoice-store, and queued email resend. output summary:
```
backfill_summary: regenerated=48, deduped=12, skipped=0, duration=32m
```
Raj: notifying CS and collections. prepping credit memos for affected accounts. will send customer comms template in #support.
Amanda: finance confirmed estimated credits $1,375. I'll attach the approval and run the journals after CS sign-off.
Sofia: CS will start proactive notify this afternoon with template and credit applied. leaving thread for audit notes.
Mia: great work team — please add postmortem once we close the incident. assigning owners: Leo (fix + backfill), Raj (customer comms + credits), Amanda (journal entries). closing loop later. :thumbsup:
